old: When presenting the audit, first explain in plain Korean what 실사표 is and why it is done: example data is mixed in, and untrue courses, reviews or figures risk visitor trust and false-advertising exposure (fake reviews especially).
When the owner asks only to LOCATE a phrase or claim, change nothing; scan and report.

Report as a visual dashboard (`::preview`), not a decision widget: KPI cards, then sections by visibility — ① visible now, hardcoded ② visible now from DB ③ chatbot verbatim sources ④ unpublished rows ⑤ code-only.
"지워도 계속 되살아난다" (claim keeps coming back): The cause is usually an instruction source rather than the live data. ... Ready-made: `scripts/instruction-source-scan.py`.
One shared code constant can fan a sentence out to many surfaces (e.g. `funding.ts` `VOUCHER.notPayable` fed 7 course pages, /tuition, FAQ and the chatbot).
Measure before/after with a BAD-phrase regex, not the bare topic word: correct copy (「실습 재료비는 교습비에 포함」) keeps the word on the page, so "재료비 count" never reaches 0.
Text baked into hero/banner IMAGES: download the HeroSlide images and read them; alt text alone can't be fixed in DB.
Other sessions edit the same copy in parallel, so never recommend from an earlier scan.

Find the LIVE sha ... and classify every hit: gone live / fixed in code but awaiting deploy / still present (code or DB) / unpublished. A committed but undeployed fix is still visible to visitors — say so.
Capacity sweep needs the loose variants too. ... Scan for `소수|정예|선착|밀착|일대일|1:1`, then read the context.
Also check our Naver blog (blog.naver.com/a5445380; b2750838 is a competitor). Its 2025-12~2026-01 posts share a pasted footer: 「선착순 10명모집 기능장수업」 ... Only the owner can edit it.
「조리기능장 직강」 is true and stays (owner re-confirmed 2026-10-24, along with the Naver Place line 「이수진 원장이 직접 가르치는」).
Build the decision widget ... one `<select data-key="<type>:<id>" data-rec="<recommended>">` per item ... Regenerate it from FRESH live data every time.
If the owner says they sent it unchanged and no payload arrived, treat it as accepting every recommended value; the widget's `data-rec` is the decision.
Check zero states before hiding the last items of a kind ... Release that code BEFORE the data change, so the live page is never blank in between.

Item checklist (where untrue content hides): published courses, manual ScheduleEntry rows, seed notices (~45–50자, 7–8월), all reviews, expired hero banners, Instructor coursesJson/worksJson, capacity claims, pass-rate numbers, facility descriptions, ChatFaq, refund text.
